findings.description: Executes user‑provided command with shell=True, allowing command injection
findings.rationale: Shell interprets special characters, so an attacker can inject additional commands or alter execution flow
findings.suggested_fix:
def run_user_command(argument):
    return subprocess.run(argument, shell=False, check=True)
